headline.text: L2 caramel tank heaters burnt out, leakers persist on ML3 — L3 truffle tunnel cover dropped, *4,107 lbs chocolate on hold*.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran all lines with minimal interruption. Sollich 2 accumulated 34 bins at the matrix overnight, paused 20 minutes to clear at 05:51, floors back to normal by 06:04.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML3 leakers continue — 5-10 per mold at shift start — despite air bubble mitigation. Caramel tank heaters burnt out at 06:37, maintenance replacing. Chocolate jam cleared in 6 minutes. FFS material shortage flagged for Friday startup.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML1 was down for C6 belt replacement until 05:25, back online but Bosch paper roller bouncing. Truffle Line lost tunnel 4 cover overnight, workaround in place, cooling tunnel repair pending. 4,107 lbs chocolate remains on hold awaiting resolution. MF Matrix roller not working at shift start, maintenance called.

notes.text: Hershey chocolate loaded and running, no recipe in system — team selected closest match, action item opened to create new recipe.
Theegarten vendor visit scheduled for 1:30 PM.

resolved.title: Matrix accumulation on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: 34 bins accumulated overnight at top of matrix, pouches on floor, paused 20 minutes to clear.

resolved.title: ML3 chocolate stuck in conveyor
resolved.summary: Chocolate jammed in conveyor at 07:09, brief line stop.

resolved.summary: Line stopped at 10:04 for maintenance to clean tooling.

resolved.summary: Line down since prior shift for C6 belt failure, replacement and ATP in progress.
resolved.resolution: Belt running, line up, passed ATP at 05:25.

needs_attention.title: ML3 caramel tank heaters burnt out
needs_attention.summary: Tank temperature control lost, heaters need replacement before depositing can resume.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on-site replacing heaters as of 06:37, depositing stopped at 07:04.

needs_attention.title: ML3 leakers — 5-10 per mold
needs_attention.summary: Caramel air bubbles causing persistent seal leaks, mitigation attempted but issue continues.
needs_attention.status: Erandy identified air bubbles in caramel as root cause, manual dumping tested. Alan reports 5-10 leakers per mold still present at 06:24.

needs_attention.title: FFS material shortage for Friday run
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrap, boxes, and WIP not staged at L2 for scheduled Friday startup.
needs_attention.status: Luis Pino tagged to order material, no confirmation of order placed as of 00:42.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line 4,107 lbs chocolate on hold
needs_attention.summary: Three pallets without labels, awaiting FSQA resolution before final labeling can proceed.
needs_attention.status: Preston notes chocolate may have been added to melter July 15, needs to compare notes before releasing. No resolution as of 20:32.

needs_attention.summary: Operator dropped tunnel 4 cover overnight, cooling tunnel requires maintenance fix.
needs_attention.status: Covers slid to close gap as workaround by 05:48. Maintenance to repair after ML1 belt work complete. Cover sitting on conveyor, needs proper staging.

needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 06:59, no update by window close.
